messages:
Jordan P: Heads-up thread: Customer B wants an EU-first experiment with strict telemetry and a rapid fallback. Need concise cutover plan + ownership.
Liz M: TL;DR: micro-canary -> regional ramp -> full. Need telemetry contract and legal ok for payload samples.
Mike G: Technical constraints: use `model-eu-v2-q4` variant, quantized. Pre-warm EU pool, allocate +30% burst reserve.
Sam O: Ops requirement: emergency routing must be able to switch to global fallback in <=20s. Who wires that into runbooks?
Ada S: SRE will implement the fast-fail circuit. Proposed triggers: 1) 5xx rate >1% sustained for 120s OR 2) p95 latency >2.5s for 3m. Auto-rollback sequence: disable flag slice -> drain -> route to `model-global-stable`.
Priya C: Customer asks: daily telemetry digest first 72h, then every 48h for two weeks. Must include per-tenant success rate, latency distribution, and sampled inputs (sanitized).
Jordan P: Who signs telemetry? Product drafts contract, CS coordinates with customer, Legal signs off for data-sharing, Eng-Platform implements collection. Agree?
Liz M: Agree. Also include retention window (14d for raw samples, 90d for aggregates) in the appendix.
Mike G: Flag naming proposal: `cb_custB.eu.optin.v1`. Canary plan JSON (for Console):
```
{
  "steps": [
    {"slice": "random-3pct", "duration": "2h"},
    {"slice": "eu-20pct", "duration": "18h"},
    {"slice": "eu-50pct", "duration": "24h"}
  ],
  "fallback": "model-global-stable",
  "prewarm": true
}
```
Sam O: Ops constraints: block marketing pushes during the 44h window. Pre-authorize emergency auto-scale to +50% for first 6h if traffic spike.
Ada S: Add quality gate: customer eval must not show >4% degradation on their gold prompts. We need a webhook from Customer B that posts eval score daily; if score drops, enact auto-rollback.
Priya C: We will share a redacted prompt set and baseline metrics. Customer needs webhook into their staging Slack channel; also need an API key and rotation schedule.
Mike G: Console can support webhook deliveries and key rotation. We'll provide a sanitized payload schema and PII removal steps.
Jordan P: Draft launch checklist:
- Flag created: `cb_custB.eu.optin.v1` (owner: Product)
- Canary schedule in Console (owner: Eng-Platform)
- Telemetry contract + retention (owner: Product + Legal)
- SLOs and rollback automation (owner: SRE)
- Kill-switch test in staging (owner: Ops + SRE)
- Webhook to customer staging + key rotation (owner: Eng-Platform + CS)
- Communication: no campaigns during canary (owner: Ops)
Liz M: Add approvals: Legal on samples, Security on KMS usage for keys, and CS sign-off on evaluation criteria.
Sam O: Proposed cutover: Wednesday 08:00 UTC pending signoffs. Please confirm by Tuesday EOD.
Jordan P: Volunteers for staging test? @Ada S / @Sam O to run and post results.
Ada S: I'll run kill-switch scenario tomorrow 16:00 UTC. I
'll share logs and checklist.
deploy-bot: checkpoint saved: canary-plan/custB-eu/1752612345 by Jordan P
Priya C: Customer also wants a latency heatmap at T+6h and T+24h. Can we include token-cost delta in the report?
Mike G: Yes, we'll include region heatmap + cost-per-token delta and basic throughput metrics.
Jordan P: Final action items: Product -> telemetry appendix + legal; Eng-Platform -> implement flag + webhook + prewarm; SRE -> SLO + rollback automation; Ops -> run cutover if signoffs complete. Confirm by Tuesday EOD. :white_check_mark:
